note: generalizable. thresholds and verdict logic only - no cohort measurements. a new cohort is evaluated against this same file.

authority.note: every check declares where its criterion draws its warrant from. a check with no authority field is a load error - missing must not mean permissive.

values.cohort_calibrated: the value was derived on some cohort, not from an external standard. on a cohort that has not derived it, escalate - do not inherit, do not substitute a default
values.advisory: informs only. reported, never contributes to a verdict

authority.calibration_record: {project_root}/eda_calibration.json - the cohort declares which calibrated values it derived or adopted, and on what evidence. absent file = nothing calibrated = every cohort_calibrated check escalates.
authority.why_the_numbers_are_not_here: a threshold in this file is a default, not a warrant. the warrant is per cohort and lives with the cohort, because that is the thing a second cohort must not inherit.

checks.authority_basis: no threshold. a cohort with no units is not a cohort

checks.description: known positive markers detected for the tissue/disease
checks.authority_basis: both halves are declared per project: which genes are expected, and the detection floor they must clear. neither is a property of the method
checks.forecloses: carrying one tissue's marker panel and detection floor onto another, where the panel names the wrong genes and the floor sits in the wrong place

checks.description: known negative controls absent or near-zero
checks.authority_basis: which genes count as absent is a property of the disease context, and the ceiling they must stay under is declared per project
checks.forecloses: treating a gene as a control on a cohort where it is expected to be present, which turns a passing check into evidence of nothing

checks.description: Moran's I > threshold for >= k of the top n positive markers
checks.routes: selects the molecular encoder branch (spatial GNN vs non-spatial)
checks.authority_basis: no external basis. published spatially-variable-gene work selects by FDR-adjusted p or by rank, not by a raw magnitude bar; multi-sample practice aggregates ranks or combines p-values rather than taking a median; and the cohort-level question this check actually asks - is this dataset structured enough to justify a spatial encoder - has no published precedent at all. the magnitude bar and the k-of-n count are this package's conventions, defensible by argument only
checks.forecloses: routing a new cohort's molecular encoder on a magnitude bar tuned somewhere else. this is the one check whose result changes the pipeline's shape rather than its parameters

checks.description: technical silhouette <= biological silhouette, or both <= 0
checks.authority_basis: split criterion. the comparative half - technical must not exceed biological - holds anywhere. the absolute floor is a magnitude bar with no external source, so the check as a whole is calibrated
checks.forecloses: a cohort with weaker biological separation reading its batch structure as acceptable because the inherited floor happens to sit above it

checks.description: encoder input format decided; blocking if unresolved
checks.authority_basis: resolved-or-not is a property of the field. the measurement behind it - are the values integer counts - is a property of the matrix, not a threshold. a directory named raw is not evidence anywhere
was correspondence verified - a boolean with no threshold behind it
the categories are a fixed vocabulary (decisions.md A11), not a measured bar. which category an encoder-tissue pair lands in is cohort-specific; that it must land in one is not

checks.description: cell segmentation QC, single-cell-resolution platforms only
checks.authority_basis: boolean. the platform-specific minima that would make it calibrated are not declared in this contract

caution_if: spatial_autocorrelation_pass false but Moran's I > caution_floor for most markers
a required check is null rather than measured
a cohort_calibrated check has no calibration record for this cohort
verdict_rule.escalation_note: a cohort_calibrated check with no calibration record is not evaluated at all. it escalates through the gate's existing interrupt - the workflow pauses, checkpoints, and resumes at that point. there is no default.

learned_checks.note: checks established in practice but never encoded in EDA.md. advisory in contract 1.1 - reported, never verdict-changing. `promotes_to` records the authority each would carry if it became a gating check, so the classification is settled before the promotion rather than during it.

items.description: every check records which matrix it read
items.rationale: a directory named raw may hold normalized values; filenames are not evidence

items.description: unit count at each stage plus a reason for every drop
items.rationale: aggregate counts cannot be reconciled after the fact

items.description: encoder-specific minimum unit count per sample
items.rationale: below an encoder's prototype count, zero-shot inference is undefined
items.promotion_basis: the floor is a property of the encoder, so it moves whenever the encoder does; the depth bands that route around it are measured per cohort. neither survives a change of either

items.description: NMI(candidate_label, subject_id) before any clustering metric
items.rationale: a subject-level label makes clustering a subject-classification task
items.promotion_basis: the failure it guards against is general, but the cut point has no external source. provenance unknown, so it does not promote to universal

items.description: fraction of samples carrying each annotation
items.rationale: determines which hypotheses are answerable at all

items.description: flag any cohort-level statistic computed on one sample
items.rationale: an n=1 measurement should not gate a cohort decision
